title: HECM Monthly Servicing Fee: Charging and Correction
content:
**Rule.** A monthly servicing fee is charged on a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) only when the loan's servicing fee option is the monthly fee with a servicing fee set-aside; a loan whose servicing fee is included in the rate is never charged a servicing fee.

**Amount.** The fee is the plan's monthly-adjustable servicing fee when the loan's rate type is monthly adjustable, and the plan's annual-adjustable-or-fixed servicing fee when the rate type is annual adjustable or fixed.

**Posting.** The fee for a month is posted on the plan's assessment day of the following month and belongs to the month it is for, and the same amount is drawn from the loan's Servicing Fee Set-Aside.

**When charged.** A servicing fee is charged only while the loan status is active, due and payable or deferral period; no fee is charged for a month that ended before the loan funded or after the month the loan was paid in full or claim-terminated. Each fee month is charged once.

**Correction.** A fee charged on a loan whose option is included in the rate, or charged twice for the same month, is reversed in full by one advance reversal of no advance type, referencing the erroneous fee, and the set-aside draw it caused is refunded to the set-aside.

| Servicing fee option | Rate type | Monthly fee |
|---|---|---|
| included in the rate | any | none |
| monthly fee with set-aside | monthly adjustable | the plan's monthly-adjustable fee |
| monthly fee with set-aside | annual adjustable or fixed | the plan's annual-adjustable-or-fixed fee |

*Hypothetical:* a fee for March charged a second time is reversed in full, and the second set-aside draw is refunded; the first March fee stands.
